mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_take (take_no, status, operator, remark) VALUES (#{takeNo}, #{status}, #{operator}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO stock_take_item (take_id, product_id, system_qty) VALUES
(#{item.takeId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.systemQty})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.take_no, t.status, t.operator, t.remark, t.created_at, t.finished_at, i.id AS item_id, i.product_id, p.name AS product_name, i.system_qty, i.actual_qty, i.diff_qty FROM stock_take t LEFT JOIN stock_take_item i ON i.take_id = t.id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT id, take_no AS takeNo, status, operator, remark, created_at AS createdAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM stock_take ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_take SET status = #{status}, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} > 0 THEN NOW() ELSE finished_at END WHERE id = #{id}
